basic_query.desc: 基础查询 API，用于按条件查询当前 dataview 的字段。
basic_query.call_pattern: r{id} = {api_name}(filter, order, limit, realtime) -> field1, field2
examples:
r1 = stock.quote(filter = "tradedate = -1 and amount > 1000000000", order = "amount desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, tradedate, close, pct, amount
note: -x 表示前 x 个交易日；tradedate = -1 表示上一个交易日。filter支持当前view支持的所有的field

r2 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 600519.SH", realtime = 2, limit = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, minute_index, open, close, high, low, pct, amount, volumn
note: stock.quote 的 realtime=2 表示09:30以后的最新一分钟K，即最新行情。

r3 = index.quote(filter = "code in r2.code and (pct > 1 or amount > 5000000000)", order = "pct desc", limit = 10, realtime = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, pct, amount
note: filter 支持`and or in`等常见操作， 出现 or 时，or 条件必须用括号包住。同时 filter也支持引用前面步骤的结果作为条件; realtime=1表示当前是查询实时行情/资金/量价等信息，而 =0 则表示当前查询的是T-1历史天级别数据

r4 = stock.quote(filter = "code = 600519.SH", order = "minute_index asc", limit = 240, realtime = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, minute_index, open, close, high, low, amount, volumn
note: stock.quote 的 realtime=1 表示查询从09:30开始的分钟K序列，盘前快照不返回。
basic_query.output_rule: 输出字段只能从当前 view.fields 中选择
rules: 只能用定义的字段，不允许新造不存在的字段
realtime 是统一可选参数；stock.quote 使用三态：0=历史日K，1=从09:30开始的分钟K序列，2=09:30以后的最新一分钟K（最新行情）。其他 API 按各自 dataview 说明使用。
对 stock.quote：明确历史日期、历史区间、上一个交易日或过去K日/近N天窗口时使用 realtime=0；需要从09:30开始的分钟K序列时使用 realtime=1；当前、此刻、实时、盘中最新或最新行情使用 realtime=2。盘前快照不作为分钟K返回。

kday_metric.desc: K 日窗口指标 API，用于对行情、资金或估值字段做近 K 个交易日窗口计算。
kday_metric.call_pattern: r{id} = {api_name}(k, filter, order, limit, realtime) -> code, name, value as alias
examples:
r2 = stock.quote.kd_pct_sum(k = 5, filter = "code in r1.code", order = "value desc", limit = 3, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as pct_5d
note:表示查询第一步返回的股票的最近五日的总涨幅,并取最高的三条

r3 = plate.moneyflow.kd_main_net_avg(k = 5, as_of = -1, filter = "plate_code in r2.plate_code", order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as avg_main_net_5d
note: as_of 是 K 日窗口参考交易日，不是普通行过滤条件；as_of = -1 表示以上一个交易日作为窗口参考日。

r4 = index.quote.kd_close_high(k = 20, filter = "code = 000300.SH", realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as high_close_20d
note: k 是该类 API 的必填参数；如果请求没有要求排序或取前几，则省略 order 和 limit。

r5 = stock.pricevalue.kd_pe_percentile(k = 750, filter = "code = 600519.SH", realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as pe_percentile_3y
note: 估值百分位默认按当前最新交易日往前计算；用户说1年/3年/5年时，将 k 写成 250/750/1250。

r6 = stock.pricevalue.kd_pe_percentile(k = 500, filter = "code in r1.stock_code and value <= 0.1", order = "value asc", realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as pe_percentile_2y
note: 百分位前10%/低于10%是 value <= 0.1，不是 limit = 10。

r7 = stock.quote.kd_minute_volumn_avg(k = 10, filter = "change_pct > 20", order = "change_pct desc", limit = 20) -> code, name, current_value, value as avg_minute_volumn_10d, change_pct
note: 适合当前分钟成交量相对近10天同分钟均值的问题。
kday_metric.output_rule: 通常输出 code, name, value as alias；alias 应体现字段、方法和窗口。

optional: realtime(0|1; daily K default 0; same-minute K default 1)

rules: API name format is {subject}.{dataview}.kd_<field>_<method>.
field must be listed in current dataview.kd.
method must be listed in api_class_patterns.kday_metric.methods unless the dataview defines a special method.
日级近 K 个交易日窗口使用 realtime=0；只有明确的同一分钟 K 日比较使用对应分钟 K API 的 realtime=1。
Output usually uses code, name, value as alias.

constituent_query.desc: 成分股查询 API，用于查询主体和成分股之间的对应关系。
constituent_query.call_pattern: r{id} = {api_name}(filter, order, limit, realtime) -> {subject_code_field}, {subject_name_field}, stock_code, stock_name
examples: r1 = index.constitution(filter = "index_name = 沪深300", order = "stock_code asc", limit = 100) -> index_code, index_name, stock_code, stock_name, weight

r2 = plate.constitution(filter = "stock_code in r1.code") -> plate_code, plate_name, stock_code, stock_name
note: 如果请求没有要求排序或取前几，则省略 order 和 limit。
r3 = industry.constitution(filter = "industry_name = 银行 and stock_code in r1.code", order = "stock_code asc", limit = -1) -> industry_code, industry_name, stock_code, stock_name
constituent_query.output_rule: 输出字段只能从当前 view.fields 中选择。
rules: Use this API to query the relation between a subject and its stock constituents.
Output fields must come from the current constitution dataview.

constituent_aggregate.desc: 成分股聚合 API，用于按指数、行业、板块、基金或热点等主体统计其成分股的行情、资金、估值、财务指标；一次请求只计算一个聚合目标。
constituent_aggregate.call_pattern: r{id} = {api_name}(filter, agg, group_by, order, limit, realtime) -> {subject_code_field}, {subject_name_field}, agg_alias
examples: r2 = industry.constitution.agg(filter = "industry_name in r1.industry_name", agg = median(stock.financial_3_table.roe), group_by = "industry_code, industry_name", order = "median_roe desc", limit = -1) -> industry_code, industry_name, median_roe

r3 = plate.constitution.agg(filter = "plate_code in r2.plate_code and tradedate = -1", agg = sum(stock.quote.amount), group_by = "plate_code, plate_name", order = "total_amount desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> plate_code, plate_name, total_amount
note: -x 表示前 x 个交易日；这里 tradedate = -1 用于成分股行情指标的交易日过滤。

r4 = industry.constitution.agg(filter = "stock_code in r3.code", agg = avg(r3.interval_return), group_by = "industry_code, industry_name") -> industry_code, industry_name, avg_return
note: agg 使用 rN.column 时，rN 必须是逐股票结果，且 SESSION RESULTS 中必须包含 code 或 stock_code。

r5 = index.constitution.agg(filter = "index_name = 沪深300 and pct > 0", agg = count(stock.quote.code), group_by = "index_code, index_name") -> index_code, index_name, up_count
note: 上涨家数等条件计数可以在 filter 中叠加 pct > 0，再用 count(stock.quote.code)。
constituent_aggregate.output_rule: 输出主体标识字段和一个聚合结果别名字段；一个 agg 请求只计算一个目标，多个指标拆成多个步骤。
rules: agg format is method(metric), for example avg(stock.quote.pct), sum(stock.moneyflow.main_net), count(stock.quote.code), median(r3.interval_return). Tuple format (avg, stock.quote.pct) is also accepted by code.
metric can be any defined dataview field path like stock.pricevalue.pe or stock.moneyflow.main_net, or a previous per-stock result field like r3.interval_return.
When agg uses rN.column, rN must include code or stock_code.
group_by must use fields from the current constitution dataview.
Output must include group fields and one aggregate alias field.

financial_query.desc: 财务查询 API，用于查询财务三张表和财务指标。
financial_query.call_pattern: r{id} = {api_name}(filter, order, limit, realtime) -> field1, field2
examples:
r1 = stock.financial_3_table(filter = "code = 000001.SZ and report_period = 2025-12-31", order = "report_date desc", limit = 1) -> code, name, report_date, revenue, net_profit, roe
note: 财务报告期写在 filter 中，例如 report_period = 2025-12-31。
r2 = stock.financial_3_table(filter = "revenue_yoy > 20 and statement_type = HB", order = "revenue_yoy desc", limit = 20) -> code, name, report_date, revenue, revenue_yoy

r3 = stock.financial_3_table(filter = "code in r1.code and report_period >= 2024-01-01", order = "report_date desc", limit = 8) -> code, name, report_date, revenue, profit, total_assets
note: -x 交易日语义不用于 report_period。

r4 = stock.financial_3_table(filter = "code in r1.code") -> code, name, report_date, revenue, net_profit
note: 如果请求没有要求排序或取前几，则省略 order 和 limit。
financial_query.output_rule: 输出字段从当前 view.fields 中选择；支持的同比/环比字段使用 <base_field>_yoy 或 <base_field>_qoq。
rules: Use fields from the current financial dataview.
Computed fields follow current dataview.computed naming rules.

report_query.desc: 研报结构化查询 API，用于查询个股研报的评级、核心观点、风险、目标价和预测指标。
report_query.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.report(filter, order, limit) -> field1, field2
examples: r1 = stock.report(filter = "code = 300750.SZ and report_date >= 2026-01-01 and report_date <= 2026-07-28", order = "report_date desc", limit = 10) -> code, name, report_date, institution, rating, investment_highlights, risk_warnings

r2 = stock.report(filter = "code = 300750.SZ and metric_code = eps and forecast_year >= 2026", order = "forecast_year asc", limit = 20) -> report_id, code, report_date, metric_name, forecast_year, metric_value, unit, value_type
note: metric_code/metric_name/forecast_year/metric_value 触发指标级查询。
r3 = stock.report(filter = "code in r1.code and report_date >= 2025-01-01", order = "report_date desc", limit = 20) -> report_id, code, report_date, rating, target_price_lower, target_price_upper
report_query.output_rule: 输出字段只能从当前 report dataview.fields 中选择。报告字段返回研报级记录；指标字段返回指标级记录；混合字段按研报ID关联。
rules: 数据源固定为 REPORT_DB_URL 指向数据库中的 chatbi_report_v 和 chatbi_metric_v 两个视图。
report_date/report_period 表示研报发布日期，不是财务报表报告期；时间段用 >= 和 <= 两个条件表达。
包含 metric_code、metric_name、forecast_year、value_type、metric_value 等字段时使用指标级结果；其他情况使用研报级结果。
目标价使用 target_price_lower 和 target_price_upper，不依据底层视图中文别名的字面顺序。
不使用 realtime 或交易日偏移语义，研报日期是自然日/发布时间。

dynamic_quote_cal.desc: 行情动态计算 API，用于处理固定行情方法无法直接表达的复杂筛选、区间统计、组合条件和自定义指标计算。
dynamic_quote_cal.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.quote.dynamic_cal(k, filter, fields, task, order, limit, realtime) -> code, name, calculated_field1, calculated_field2
examples: r1 = stock.quote.dynamic_cal(k = 20, filter = "all", fields = "code, name, tradedate, open, close", task = "统计每只股票近20个交易日收盘价高于开盘价的天数，并保留天数大于15的股票", order = "close_gt_open_days desc", limit = -1, realtime = 0) -> code, name, close_gt_open_days

r2 = stock.quote.dynamic_cal(k = 20, filter = "all", fields = "code, name, tradedate, open, close, high, low", task = "统计每只股票近20个交易日收盘价高于开盘价的天数和十字星天数", order = "close_gt_open_days desc", limit = 20, realtime = 0) -> code, name, close_gt_open_days, doji_days

r3 = stock.quote.dynamic_cal(k = 20, fields = "code, name, tradedate, open, close", task = "统计每只股票近20个交易日收盘价高于开盘价的天数", realtime = 0) -> code, name, close_gt_open_days
note: 如果请求没有原始数据筛选、排序或取前几要求，则省略 filter、order 和 limit；task 仍然必填。

r4 = stock.quote.dynamic_cal(k = 10, fields = "code, name, tradedate, minute_index, minute_volumn", task = "计算当前分钟成交量相对过去10个交易日同分钟均值的增长百分比，并筛选增长超过20%的股票", order = "growth_pct desc", limit = -1) -> code, name, minute_volumn, avg_minute_volumn_10d, growth_pct
dynamic_quote_cal.output_rule: fields 只列取数所需 quote 字段；task 用精炼自然语言描述计算规则；输出列可以包含 quote 原始字段和 dynamic_cal 新生成的计算字段；dynamic_cal 输出计算字段名，不使用 value as alias。
rules: Use this API only when fixed APIs cannot express the requested quote calculation.
task is concise natural language; do not write Python in the request.
fields lists quote fields needed by the calculation.
When realtime=1/2 uses minute data, the sequence starts at 09:30 and excludes pre-market snapshots.

kday_margin_metric.desc: 两融 K 日窗口指标 API，用于对融资融券字段做近 K 个有数据交易日的合计、均值、最大、最小、中位数、变化值和变化率等计算。
kday_margin_metric.call_pattern: r{id} = {api_name}(k, filter, order, limit, realtime) -> code, name, value as alias
examples:
r1 = stock.margin.kd_financing_net_buy_sum(k = 5, order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as financing_net_buy_5d
note: 用户问近K日合计/累计时，使用 sum。

r2 = stock.margin.kd_financing_balance_sum(k = 5, order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as financing_balance_sum_5d
note: 如果用户明确要求融资余额求和，按请求使用 sum。

r3 = stock.margin.kd_financing_balance_change(k = 5, order = "value desc", limit = 10, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as financing_balance_change_5d
note: 用户问近K日变化时，使用 change。

r4 = stock.margin.kd_financing_balance_pct_change(k = 5, filter = "value > 10", order = "value desc", limit = 20, realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as financing_balance_pct_change_5d
note: pct_change 输出百分比，计算为 (latest - first) / first * 100。

r5 = stock.margin.kd_financing_balance_avg(k = 5, filter = "code = 300750.SZ", realtime = 0) -> code, name, value as avg_financing_balance_5d
note: 用户问近K日均值时，使用 avg。
kday_margin_metric.output_rule: 输出字段从当前 dataview 字段、value、k、start_date、end_date、window_count、start_value、current_value 中选择；value 可使用 as alias。
rules: API name format is stock.margin.kd_<field>_<method>.
field must be one of the margin dataview numeric fields listed in kd.
Prefer sum, avg, max, min, median, change, or pct_change when user wording maps naturally to these methods.
If user wording maps to a syntactically valid kd_<field>_<method> call that is not listed, keep the literal method name instead of making extra business judgements.
change and pct_change compare the latest value with the starting value in the K-day window.

fallback.condition: field is a margin field and method is a syntactically valid identifier but is not registered in kd/method_apis
fallback.observability: result sql_shape includes requested_method and executed_method

intraday_cross_section_aggregate.desc: 行情横截面聚合 API，用于对一组标的的行情字段做 avg/sum/max/min/median/count 等聚合；一次请求只计算一个聚合目标。
intraday_cross_section_aggregate.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.quote.agg(filter, agg, group_by, order, limit, realtime) -> agg_alias
examples:
r1 = stock.quote.agg(filter = "minute_index = 785 and pct > 0", agg = avg(stock.quote.pct)) -> avg_pct
note: 聚合固定在同一分钟横截面。

r2 = stock.quote.agg(filter = "snapshot_slot = 13:05", agg = sum(stock.quote.amount), realtime = 1) -> total_minute_amount
note: realtime=1 时 amount 是当前分钟成交额。
r3 = stock.quote.agg(filter = "pct > 5", agg = count(stock.quote.code)) -> strong_count
intraday_cross_section_aggregate.output_rule: 输出 group_by 字段和一个聚合结果别名字段；不需要分组时可以只输出别名字段。
rules: This API aggregates quote rows across stocks at one time point.
agg format is method(metric), for example avg(stock.quote.pct), sum(stock.quote.minute_amount), count(stock.quote.code). Tuple format (avg, stock.quote.pct) is also accepted by code.
For stock.quote realtime=1/2, amount/volumn are per-minute values; minute_amount/minute_volumn are compatibility aliases.
Minute rows start at 09:30; pre-market snapshots are excluded.
One agg request computes one target; split multiple metrics into multiple steps.

intraday_same_minute_kday_metric.desc: 行情 K 日同分钟指标 API，用于比较当前分钟成交量、成交额等与近 K 个交易日同一时刻的水平。
intraday_same_minute_kday_metric.call_pattern: r{id} = stock.quote.kd_<field>_<method>(k, filter, order, limit, realtime) -> code, name, current_value, value as alias, window_count
examples:
r1 = stock.quote.kd_minute_amount_avg(k = 5, filter = "code = 600519.SH", order = "value desc", limit = 1) -> code, name, tradedate, minute_index, current_value, value as avg_minute_amount_5d, change_pct, window_count
note: value 是过去5个交易日同一分钟的 minute_amount 均值，current_value 是当前分钟实际成交额，change_pct 是相对均值变化百分比。

r2 = stock.quote.kd_minute_amount_percentile(k = 10, filter = "pct > 0", order = "value desc", limit = 20) -> code, name, current_value, value as minute_amount_pctile_10d
note: percentile 表示当前分钟成交额在过去10个交易日同一分钟历史值中的分位，越接近1表示越放量。

r3 = stock.quote.kd_volumn_max(k = 5, filter = "snapshot_slot = 13:05", order = "current_value desc", limit = 10) -> code, name, current_value, value as max_minute_volume_5d
note: realtime=1/2 时 volumn 是该分钟成交量。

r4 = stock.quote.kd_minute_volumn_avg(k = 10, filter = "change_pct > 20", order = "change_pct desc", limit = 20) -> code, name, current_value, value as avg_minute_volumn_10d, change_pct, window_count
note: 表示当前分钟成交量超过过去10个交易日同一分钟均值20%的股票。
intraday_same_minute_kday_metric.output_rule: 通常输出 code, name, tradedate, minute_index, current_value, value as alias, change_pct, window_count；value 的含义由方法决定：avg/max/min/median 为历史统计值，percentile 为当前值相对历史同分钟的分位；change_pct 表示 current_value 相对 value 的变化百分比。
rules: API name format is stock.quote.kd_<field>_<method>.
For stock.quote realtime=1/2, amount/volumn are per-minute values; minute_amount/minute_volumn are compatibility aliases.
Same-minute windows use minute rows from 09:30 onward and exclude pre-market snapshots.
For 当前分钟成交量超过近N天均值20% questions, use method avg and filter change_pct > 20.
percentile returns the percentile of current_value among previous K same-minute historical values.

_meta.desc: 股票主体，用于上市公司及股票相关的基础信息、行情、资金流、估值、财务、股东、两融等查询。
rules: When the user asks about a specific company or stock, prefer stock as subject.

basic_info.desc: 股票基础信息视图，用于查询公司名称、股票代码、所属行业、上市信息、公司简介和主营业务等描述性信息。

api.api_function: 查询个股基础身份信息。

quote.desc: 个股行情视图。realtime=0 返回历史日K；realtime=1 返回从09:30开始的分钟K序列；realtime=2 仅返回09:30以后的最新一分钟K，即最新行情。盘前快照不返回。

name: 股票名称
证券名称
name
open: 开盘价（元；realtime=1/2 时为分钟开盘价，09:30取当日开盘价）
close: 收盘价（元；realtime=1/2 时为分钟收盘价）
amount: 成交额（元；realtime=1/2 时为分钟成交额）
minute_amount: 分钟成交额（元，amount 的兼容别名）
minute_volumn: 分钟成交量（手，volumn 的兼容别名；1手=100股）

api.api_function: 查询个股行情：realtime=0 为历史日K，realtime=1 为从09:30开始的分钟K序列，realtime=2 为09:30以后的最新一分钟K（最新行情）；盘前快照不返回。
计算个股近K日行情窗口指标，例如累计涨幅、均值、最高值、最低值、中位数和同时间点对比。
对一组股票的行情字段做横截面聚合统计，例如平均涨跌幅、成交额合计、数量统计。
处理复杂行情计算，例如区间条件统计、相对历史窗口变化、组合筛选和自定义行情指标。

rules: stock.quote 的 realtime=0 返回历史日K。
stock.quote 的 realtime=1 从09:30开始返回分钟K序列，盘前快照不返回。
09:30第一根分钟K的open取当日开盘价，amount/volumn取09:30时点累计值；后续分钟open取上一分钟close，amount/volumn取相邻分钟累计值之差。
stock.quote 的 realtime=2 仅返回09:30以后的最新一分钟K，即最新行情。
历史行情使用 realtime=0，从09:30开始的分钟K序列使用 realtime=1，当前或最新行情使用 realtime=2。

api.api_function: 查询个股在报告日期范围内的研报结构化信息和预测指标。

rules: 只查询 REPORT_DB_URL 指向数据库中的 chatbi_report_v 和 chatbi_metric_v 两个视图。
报告字段查询返回研报级记录；包含 metric_code、metric_name、forecast_year 或 metric_value 时返回指标级记录。
同一请求同时使用报告字段和指标字段时，按研报ID关联两个视图。
code 同时接受 6 位代码和 CODE.EXCHANGE；provider 会按研报视图的 6 位代码格式归一化。
metric_code 只能使用 value_domains 中的 8 个标准编码；不要臆造指标编码。metric_name 使用对应的标准中文名。
用户问预测值时必须加入 value_type = forecast；用户问历史实际值时使用 value_type = actual。
用户指定预测年份时，必须在 filter 中加入 forecast_year 条件，不能只返回全部年度指标后再自行挑选。
report_date/report_period 是研报发布日期，不是财务报表报告期；按日期范围使用 >= 和 <= 两个边界条件。
目标价字段按语义返回 target_price_lower 和 target_price_upper；不要直接使用底层视图的中文别名判断上下限。
需要完整返回符合条件的研报或指标记录时使用 limit = -1；若返回行数达到 limit，不得表述为全部数据。

rules: 基础明细查询使用 stock.margin，通过 filter/order/limit 表达筛选、排序和取前N。
K 日窗口方法使用 stock.margin.kd_<field>_<method>；常见 method 从 sum/avg/max/min/median/change/pct_change 中按用户语义直译选择。
问近K日合计/均值/最大/最小/中位数/变化/变化率时，分别使用 sum/avg/max/min/median/change/pct_change。
融资余额、两融余额等余额类指标也按用户字面要求选择方法，不在此处做业务裁判。

fallback.rule: 如果 field 是两融字段且 method 是合法标识符，即使 method 未在 method_apis 注册，也保留该 kd_<field>_<method> 调用。
